author: Yffe
content: Built the contract-TV forge integration (#144) + the off-corpus generator (#142). thermite-lower gains lower_contract_expr (the per-clause P_production, reusing the spec-context lower_expr path). thermite-tv gains generate_clauses (deterministic SplitMix64 over the frozen sublanguage, no thermite-lower dep). forge/src/contract_tv.rs runs the per-clause equivalence obligation (P_production <==> ref_contract_pred) through real verus over corpus clauses AND generated clauses, exposed as a separate `forge tv` subcommand. Approach: bind slice params as Seq (slices=[] to lower_contract_expr) to match the reference seq-bound identity @-view; frame loop locals; honestly Skip unframable clauses (Map/Option/Match/Ref) rather than false-faithful. The off-corpus run surfaced a real lowering bug (cast-< paren ambiguity), fixed in lower_binary_operand (#146).
